items.problem: On a clean migration with zero deferred files, Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 emits '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency'.
items.evidence: Migration session-log validation output (~line 4925): the WARN fired even though nothing was deferred and the build was clean (1386 warnings, 0 WUI analyzer warnings).
items.skill_search: grep 'DEFERRED', 'No items deferred', '(none)' across Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1
items.wrong_text_if_any: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 (empty-defer branch): `if ($deferredKeys.Count -eq 0) { [void]$dlines.Add('| (none) | — |') }`  ;  Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: `if ($deferText -notmatch 'No items deferred') { Write-Host '[WARN] ...' }`
items.root_cause: The two migration-skill scripts disagree on the empty-defer sentinel: the seeder writes a table placeholder row '(none)', but the validator only suppresses the WARN when the file contains the literal text 'No items deferred'.
items.proposed_fix: In Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1's empty-defer branch, also write the 'No items deferred.' sentinel line the validator checks for.
items.generalizes: Most simple UWP SDK samples defer nothing (no unsupported APIs). Every such migration currently trips this spurious WARN, adding noise that can push an agent to mis-declare a FAIL or waste turns investigating. Fixing the seeder/validator contract helps all zero-deferral scenarios.
